proposals.title: Guided Contour shortcut that creates a derived-layer recipe
proposals.summary: contourGenerator takes numeric field + auto|manual levels (Buffer-shaped with enrich cachedLevels). Analyze has no Contour for this layer control; help/analysis/contour.md already matches TIN iso-line honesty. Mirror AnalyzeTopNGuide / Fishnet: short form (field, auto interval, optional min/max), POST single-step contour derived_layer; gate to point geometryType; surface density / MAX_LEVELS honesty. Skip manual level-list UI in v1.
proposals.rationale: Next Buffer-shaped Analyze shortcut after R10 fishnet/top-n/random-sample. Elevation / signal iso-lines are a common free substitute for ArcGIS Contour seats; help already honest from R7. Constrained auto+interval keeps the form Buffer-shaped (R10 rejected full Contour UI).
proposals.risk: Dense point sets are slow (generator comments). Gate to points; prefer auto+interval only; say no iso-polygons / no smoothing. Reuse Top N field picker + enrich path; do not invent hex bands.
proposals.ethosFit: Free TIN contours on your PostGIS. Honest about density cost and line-only output.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add analyze-contour-guide (point layers, field, auto interval); link contour.md; What's new + CHANGELOG + locale catalogs.

proposals.title: Guided Group-by shortcut that creates a derived-layer recipe
proposals.summary: aggregateGenerator takes groupBy keys + aggs (count/sum/avg/min/max/first) with ST_Union geometry. Analyze has no Group by for this layer control; help/analysis/group-by.md already matches. Mirror Top N: constrained form with one group key (optional empty = whole-layer rollup) + one aggregate (count, or sum/avg on a numeric field); POST single-step aggregate derived_layer. Leave multi-key / multi-agg to the builder.
proposals.rationale: Keyed dissolve / rollup is the remaining single-layer Analyze gap that is still Buffer-shaped with a field picker. Complements no-param Dissolve without inventing a second dissolve path.
proposals.risk: Do not ship a full multi-agg spreadsheet UI. Cap to one group key + one agg in the shortcut; surface ST_Union honesty and NULL-as-group. Reuse Top N field picker + Analyze i18n pattern.
proposals.ethosFit: Free keyed rollup on your PostGIS. Guided field pick over ArcGIS Summary Statistics seats.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add analyze-group-by-guide (one key, one agg); link group-by.md; What's new + CHANGELOG + locale catalogs.
